routes.allowlist_reason: The create executes the full ODPS product-creation workflow (schema validation chain + external workflow steps) and the payload carries no tenant-scoped FK reference surface, so neither the create half nor the payload-FK direction is probeable in the DB-only security job.  The tenant boundary for contract creation is pinned by the standard contract-create probe (POST /api/v1/contracts/) and the contracts IDOR suites (tests/security/test_idor_contracts.py).

The create runs SSRF host validation with live DNS resolution — a synthetic probe hostname can never pass, and the payload carries no tenant-scoped FK reference surface for the payload-FK direction. The workspace object-level IDOR probes (GET/PATCH/DELETE detail routes) stay probed by the matrix.
